checks.observation: For arbitrary finite F, hI gives |F|≤81. Failure of |F|≤80 forces equality81; only in that branch are support17 and the two profiles derived. Their exclusions close that branch, so support17 is not a hypothesis of the final universal bound. The expanded proposition contains no hidden fixed-ground-set condition, no assumed A/B negation, and no unproved I(27) certificate. The abstract, main statements and conclusion preserve this structure.

checks.observation: The residual structure contains geometric and degree data, not the excluded-profile conclusion. H2 inherits four-uniformity and sunflower-freeness by subset closure and is proved intersecting before hI is applied. The census n2=n0+15 already gives H2 nonempty; choosing a row then yields n0≥9 from nine disjoint completions, hence n2≥24. Thus the later choice of a used key and the concentration contradiction do not assume the lower bound they are meant to derive.

content.summary: The integrated manuscript has a consistent end-to-end dependency structure. I(27) supplies the inherited global eighty-one reduction and the intersecting H2 ceiling; actual A and B exclusions then remove equality eighty-one. The unrestricted global conclusion does not inherit the boundary support restriction, and the unconditional two-star theorem remains separate. No logical integration defect was found.
